answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. The pearl lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the velvet is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
